summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 31 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 13 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Josh Woodward · Google VP，负责 Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio
featured.summaryEn: Google VP Josh Woodward, who leads Google Labs and the Gemini App, announced Gemini 4 Neon — frontier-grade intelligence that is faster, cheaper, and strong at following complex instructions, now available in the Gemini App. He also highlighted a new Project Genie experience for Google AI Ultra subscribers, featuring Genie 4, the Project Genie agent, and a community gallery.
featured.insightZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini App 负责人 Josh Woodward 发布 Gemini 4 Neon：定位是「前沿级智能，但更快、更便宜」，并强调它对复杂指令的遵循能力很强，已可在 Gemini App 中试用。同时他转发了 Project Genie 的新体验——面向 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户，包含 Genie 4、Project Genie agent 和社区作品廊。

featured.title: Google Labs · Google AI 工具与实验大本营
featured.summaryEn: Google Labs shipped two things. First, Project Genie now runs on Google DeepMind's Genie 4: create a world from one sentence, then prompt mid-session to edit it live while standing inside; a new agent helps build worlds conversationally, and a gallery lets users explore and remix others' worlds — available to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. Second, a new experiment, Stitch Loop: an always-on product agent that works non-stop to help lean teams build better products, with a waitlist now open.
featured.insightZh: Google Labs 这次发了两个东西。一是 Project Genie 升级到 Google DeepMind 的 Genie 4：一句话生成一个可进入的世界，并能在会话中途用 prompt 实时修改世界；新增对话式建世界的 agent，以及可浏览和 remix 他人作品的 gallery，已向符合条件的 AI Ultra 订阅用户开放。二是新实验 Stitch Loop——一个「始终在线」的产品 agent，持续不间断地帮精简团队打磨产品，目前开放候补名单。

featured.title: Notion’s Founder on the One Thing Your AI Is Missing
featured.summaryEn: Vibe coding realizes the 1960s–70s dream of software as a medium everyone can read and write, but UI and procedural logic are now easily replaced by agents — what endures is data and context, so Notion is repositioning as the context and knowledge system where teams of humans and agents collaborate. Every CEO Dan Shipper talks with Notion founder and CEO Ivan Zhao. Ivan says the spirit of vibe coding is why Notion was started, but distinguishes categories: people should be free to modify their tools; for everyday tools like calendars most people want a well-crafted, opinionated solution (Notion launched a rebuilt native mobile calendar that day); and security-critical enterprise software is better maintained by someone else — like choosing a good restaurant over cooking. On models changing every few months, he argues agents can now write the procedural code and the UI, so the durable va…
featured.insightZh: Vibe coding 让 60-70 年代「人人都能读写软件」的愿景成真，但 UI 和流程逻辑会被 agent 轻易替代，真正持久的是数据与上下文——Notion 正把自己重新定位为团队人类与 agent 协作的「上下文与知识系统」。 Every CEO Dan Shipper 对话 Notion 创始人兼 CEO Ivan Zhao。Ivan 认为 vibe coding 的精神正是 Notion 创立的初衷：让软件像读写一样成为人人可用的媒介。但他把软件分为几类：人们应有权修改自己的工具；而像日历这类日常工具，大多数人更想要别人深思熟虑后的成熟方案（Notion 当天发布了从零重写的移动端日历）；企业级、依赖安全的软件则不建议自己维护。他用「餐厅」做比喻——你可以自己做饭，但也常想去一家好餐厅。 谈到模型每几个月迭代一次带来的产品焦虑，Ivan 认为 agent 既能写流程代码也能生成 UI，因此 Notion 不再执着于这两层；更持久的是数据、上下文和语义。Notion 的职责是成为数据守护者，把上下文开放给各类 agent，并提供权限护栏与人类协作。他回顾 13 年历程：前五年在黑暗中摸索，疫情期间找到 PMF；2022 年底拿到 GPT-4 级模型后与联合创始人闭关做原型，在 ChatGPT 发布前几周上线首个 AI 产品；随后花两年做 agent 产品，直到去年才真正跑通，又发现人人都在做 agent，最终回到「上下文」这一差异化。 他也担忧二阶效应：和 AI 聊天有时像刷 TikTok，人不应放弃「理解」。团队实践是用 Notion 看板来编排多个编码 agent，以可视化重建共同理解。他提出「vibe coding 的乐高」概念——介于黏土（细粒度代码）与固定积木之间，权限、同步、协作已就绪；Notion 计划在一两个季度内为 50 人公司提供开箱即用、由 agent 引导上线的上下文方案，并假设下一批十亿「知识工作者」大多是 agent。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who works on Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, said GPT-6.2 Astra is strong at genuinely hard problems, pointing to team results on AMD and Jalapeño chip optimizations. He acknowledged feedback about its communication style and said they are working on it, but for the hardest tasks it currently seems to be in a league of its own. He also asked users how 6.2 Sol is treating them.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 表示 GPT-6.2 Astra 在「真正困难的事」上表现突出，团队分享了它在 AMD 和 Jalapeño 芯片优化上的成果。他坦言收到了关于其沟通风格的反馈、正在改进，但认为在全球最难的任务上它目前「独一档」。另外他也在征集用户对 6.2 Sol 的使用反馈。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch launched vercel board, a message-board infrastructure primitive for agents — "headless Slack," or IRC for agents. He argues message boards enabled both the Navier-Stokes math breakthrough and the OpenAI/Hugging Face cyber feat, and are a key building block for software factories, self-optimizing systems and research, where the human prompt is only the seed and millions of agents operate in a decentralized way; it is model-, harness- and hosting-agnostic. Separately, he says he is pitched…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发布 vercel board：一个面向 agent 的「留言板」基础设施原语，可理解为「无头版 Slack」或 agent 时代的 IRC。他认为留言板正是 Navier-Stokes 数学突破和 OpenAI/Hugging Face 网络安全事件背后的使能技术，是软件工厂、自优化系统和科研的关键积木——人类 prompt 只是种子，数百万 agent 去中心化协作；产品与模型、harness、托管平台无关。另一条他谈推理算力：平均每两天就有人向他推销一家新的推理 neocloud，难以想象全部可持续；但 Vercel AI Gateway 的 token 需求今年以来月均复合增长约 40%。他的解释是「算力是新经济、token 是新能源单位」，更像持久的「石油潮」而非「淘金热」；短期会继续扩张，随后因规模经济、网络安全与企业要求（如 ZDR）、资本门槛和监管而走向整合。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad said one of the most fascinating parts of the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident was reading the message boards where agents communicate. With Replit Missions, he notes, you can watch how agents coordinate and talk to each other.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 说，OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件中最有意思的一点，是能读到 agent 之间互相沟通的留言板。他借此推介 Replit Missions：用户可以直接看到多个 agent 如何协调和对话。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie says we are entering yet another era of agents: from quick answers, to agents orchestrated across tasks, to agents given goals that design the best solution, test and iterate, deploy, and continuously optimize based on execution. It will start in engineering, but the impact across knowledge work could be massive — improving client onboarding toward a target, reducing business risk, or continuously improving security posture — producing outcomes humans couldn't achieve before.
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为 AI agent 正进入又一个新阶段：从「快速给答案」到「在一组任务中被人编排」，再到下一步——给 agent 一组目标，由它设计最佳方案、测试迭代、部署，并基于执行结果持续优化。这会先在工程领域出现，但对整个知识工作影响巨大：例如让 agent 去优化客户 onboarding 流程以达成目标、降低业务风险、持续改善安全态势，最终达成人类此前做不到的结果。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code 成员
items.summaryEn: Thariq, formerly on Claude Code at Anthropic, reflected that making your own software is hard even with AI, because it's hard to know what you really want — his "modes"-based setup didn't stick, so he's trying a more to-do-oriented take. His conclusion: most people won't really generate their own software, because good software is a set of strong opinions, and he'd rather use something thoroughly thought through by someone else.
items.insightZh: 前 Claude Code 团队成员 Thariq 分享了自己用 AI 做个人软件的体会：即便有 AI，自己做软件依然很难，因为很难知道自己真正想要什么——他做的「模式」式组织方式最后没坚持用，准备换成更偏 to-do 的思路。他由此认为大多数人不会真的去生成自己的软件：好软件是一组强观点，他宁愿用别人深思熟虑过的东西。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wrote about doing DealBook with Greg Brockman, his partner of 11 years. Greg's role has evolved from writing code 100 hours a week to leading some of the hardest and most consequential parts of the business, and Altman says OpenAI would not exist without him.
items.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 谈与 Greg Brockman 一同参加 DealBook：两人合作 11 年，Greg 的角色从早期每周写 100 小时代码，演变为如今领导公司最难、最关键的部分业务。Altman 称没有 Greg 就没有 OpenAI。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang raised open questions about the Nvidia saga: what led Jensen to resign so abruptly, and was there a smoking gun? Why did a long-tenured board move on so quickly? And if there was a smoking gun, why is the president fine with Jensen coming back? He suspects outsiders — and most Nvidia employees — are missing key information.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 对 Nvidia 风波提出几个疑问：Jensen 为何突然辞职、是否有确凿证据？共事多年的董事会为何这么快翻篇？如果真有问题，为什么总统说不介意 Jensen 回归？他怀疑外界（以及大多数 Nvidia 员工）还缺少关键信息。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari shared fundraising advice: ambition is what's being rewarded right now. Ask what happens — the second- and third-order effects — if everything works, put that on the first slide, and walk investors through how what you're building earns the right to get there. A reluctant founder friend tried it and reported back four days later that it worked. He also joked about SF VCs who missed Anthropic wishing for liquidity.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 分享融资 pitch 建议：当前市场奖励的是「野心」。如果你的计划全部成功，二阶、三阶效应是什么？把这个终局放在第一页，再向投资人说明为何从现在做的事出发能「赢得走到那里的资格」。他的一位创业者朋友勉强一试，四天后反馈奏效。另有一条调侃没投 Anthropic 的湾区 VC 所期盼的「流动性」。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Former Dropbox CTO and SPC General Partner Aditya Agarwal said his data also shows that early-stage VCs complaining they can't do "AI" is copium — you just have to take more risk, be non-consensus, and work on frontier problems. He also argued stablecoins will likely be one of the biggest ways for America to exert soft power, since outside India and China most people and businesses would prefer to hold dollars.
items.insightZh: 前 Dropbox CTO、SPC 合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 表示，自己的数据也印证：早期 VC 抱怨「做不了 AI 投资」是自我安慰——你只需承担更多风险、更非共识、投前沿问题。另外他认为稳定币可能成为美国输出软实力的最大途径之一：在印度和中国以外的大多数国家，个人和企业都更愿意持有美元。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang on content growth: rather than going massively viral for one day, it's better to be a little bit viral every week and let it compound — build a system that consistently delivers high-quality content over a long period.
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 谈内容增长：与其某一天爆火，不如每周都「小火一点」并让它复利；关键是建立一个能长期持续产出高质量内容的系统。
